name: Sleep Calculator
author: Austin Larson
description: What time to go to sleep to be up at a set time, or what time to get up if you go to bed now — the arithmetic sleepcalculator.com does

barWidget.description: Bedtimes and wake-up times on 90-minute sleep cycles

schema.label: Wake time
schema.description: The time the bedtime list counts back from, as 24-hour HH:MM. Set from the panel itself; this is where the panel keeps it, so a wake time you set once is the one it opens with tomorrow night.

schema.label: Opens showing
schema.description: Which of the two questions the panel is on when it opens. Bedtime counts back from the wake time above; wakeup counts forward from right now. Also follows whichever mode you last left it in.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.
